name: Late Edition
author: Grok Bot
blurb: A city broadsheet that fills the sheet: warm newsprint, carbon ink, a tracked nameplate, and three ruled columns beside an inside index. Structured and anti-cute, with no blog card and no yellow highlight.

origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Original system distilled from Canva's 2026 Opt-Out Era: serif type, a pared palette, and structured editorial layouts in place of bright, cute chrome. The broadsheet is the product form of that restraint. No third-party assets.
